text: 国家发展改革委国家信息中心最新发布的先行指标显示，7月，我国线下消费持续升温，带动商品消费和服务消费协同向好。7月消费支付金额同比增长2.2%，增速较上月加快0.8个百分点。中小商户的经营活力稳步增强，反映中小商户经营状况的实体商业活力指数较上月提高3.1%。实体商户经营健康指数、线下消费者活力指数环比均有增长。（央视新闻）
text_en: The latest leading indicators released by the National Information Center of the National Development and Reform Commission show that in July, China's offline consumption continued to warm, driving coordinated improvement in both goods and services consumption. July consumption payment amounts rose 2.2% year-on-year, with growth accelerating by 0.8 percentage points from the previous month. The operating vitality of small and medium merchants steadily strengthened, with the physical business vitality index reflecting SME conditions up 3.1% from the previous month. Both the physical merchant operating health index and offline consumer vitality index posted month-on-month gains. (CCTV News)
